alloy.preparation: Cut from cold-rolled sheet. Surface ground to 600-grade silicon-carbide paper; additional fine polishing was used for specimens examined by optical or electron microscopy. Further preparation details are referred outside this PDF and not imported.

test_solution.preparation: 0.6 M chloride solution. Prepared from analytical reagents, sodium salts and distilled water; neutral pH approximately 7; deaerated with nitrogen for 1 h before and throughout experiments.

test_method.procedure_description: Immersed for 30 min, then potentiodynamic polarization commenced at the free-corrosion potential; potentials reported vs SCE. Separate above-threshold potentiostatic microscopy tests were used to examine pit morphology and inclusions, not to define the registered scan potential.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Potential identified from anodic polarization; authors label the temperature/mixed-halide results transpassive and/or pitting potentials, without assigning every transition marker unequivocally to one mechanism.

experiments.result_note: Source-reported range across experiments, graphically recovered; no unreported mean/replicates inferred. The paper labels these outcomes transpassive and/or pitting potentials. At the critical-temperature transition, the paper does not assign every marker unequivocally to pitting rather than transpassivity; that source uncertainty remains. Clearly nonpitting transpassive conditions have been excluded.
